summary.en: A new study shows European electric vehicle sales have hit a record high, marking what researchers call a 'pivotal' year for affordable electric cars. Falling battery costs and expanding charging networks are bringing EVs within reach of mainstream buyers. Analysts say the trend signals an accelerating shift away from petrol and diesel across the continent.
summary.zh_hans: 一项新研究显示，欧洲电动车销量创下历史新高，研究人员称今年是平价电动车的「关键一年」。电池成本下降及充电网络扩张，令电动车逐渐走入主流市场。分析认为，趋势显示欧洲正加速摆脱汽油及柴油车。
summary.zh_hant: 一項新研究顯示，歐洲電動車銷量創下歷史新高，研究人員稱今年是平價電動車的「關鍵一年」。電池成本下降及充電網絡擴張，令電動車逐漸走入主流市場。分析認為，趨勢顯示歐洲正加速擺脫汽油及柴油車。

title.en: European EV sales hit record in 'pivotal' year for affordable electric cars, study shows
title.zh_hans: 研究：欧洲电动车销量创新高　平价车迎关键一年
title.zh_hant: 研究：歐洲電動車銷量創新高　平價車迎關鍵一年

summary.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has called a snap general election for November 29, bringing the vote forward from next year. Sanchez has governed for eight years at the head of minority governments and is gambling on a fresh mandate. The election is expected to become a referendum on issues including the country's housing crisis.
summary.zh_hans: 西班牙首相桑切斯宣布提前举行大选，投票日定于11月29日，较原定明年提早。桑切斯过去八年一直以少数政府姿态执政，今次是赌上新授权的一搏。今次大选预料将围绕房屋危机等议题，成为一场变相公投。
summary.zh_hant: 西班牙首相桑切斯宣布提前舉行大選，投票日定於11月29日，較原定明年提早。桑切斯過去八年一直以少數政府姿態執政，今次是賭上新授權的一搏。今次大選預料將圍繞房屋危機等議題，成為一場變相公投。

title.en: Spain's PM Sanchez calls snap election for November 29, gambling on fresh mandate

title.en: China's National Day holiday reveals shifting tourism trends: longer trips, richer experiences
title.zh_hant: 十一黃金周旅遊趨勢：行程更長、體驗更豐富
title.zh_hans: 十一黄金周旅游趋势：行程更长、体验更丰富

summary.en: Five days into China's National Day golden-week holiday, travel agencies report holidaymakers are taking longer trips and seeking richer, experience-oriented journeys. Tours of 10 days or more accounted for 26 per cent of bookings, while former revolutionary base areas drew renewed interest. More international visitors are also flocking to China, with overseas spending up 27.8 per cent year on year in the first seven months of 2026.
summary.zh_hant: 內地十一黃金周踏入第五日，旅行社數據顯示遊客行程愈來愈長，愈來愈講求體驗。10日或以上行程佔預訂量26%，紅色旅遊景點重拾人氣。同時更多外國遊客到訪中國，今年首7個月境外旅客在華消費按年升27.8%。
summary.zh_hans: 内地十一黄金周踏入第五日，旅行社数据显示游客行程愈来愈长，愈来愈讲求体验。10日或以上行程占预订量26%，红色旅游景点重拾人气。同时更多外国游客到访中国，今年首7个月境外旅客在华消费按年升27.8%。

title.en: Yemen launches 'Dawn of Yemen' operation against Houthis with Saudi-led coalition air support
title.zh_hant: 也門發起「也門黎明」行動打擊胡塞武裝　沙特聯軍空襲支援
title.zh_hans: 也门发起「也门黎明」行动打击胡塞武装　沙特联军空袭支援

summary.en: Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council chairman Rashad al-Alimi announced the launch of 'Operation Dawn of Yemen' to restore state institutions, liberate the capital Sanaa and end the Houthi rebellion. Government forces said they have outflanked Houthi positions, seizing the Bab el-Mandeb strait and an airport in Taiz. The Saudi-led coalition said 100 warplanes took part, destroying more than 320 high-value targets.
summary.zh_hant: 也門總統領導委員會主席阿里米宣布，發起名為「也門黎明」的行動，以恢復國家機構運作、解放首都薩那，並結束胡塞武裝叛亂。政府軍表示已對胡塞武裝據點實施側翼包抄，控制曼德海峽及塔伊茲省機場。沙特主導的多國聯軍表示，100架戰機參與行動，摧毀320多個高價值目標。
summary.zh_hans: 也门总统领导委员会主席阿里米宣布，发起名为「也门黎明」的行动，以恢复国家机构运作、解放首都萨那，并结束胡塞武装叛乱。政府军表示已对胡塞武装据点实施侧翼包抄，控制曼德海峡及塔伊兹省机场。沙特主导的多国联军表示，100架战机参与行动，摧毁320多个高价值目标。

summary.en: Designer Gabriela Hearst presented her Spring-Summer 2027 collection at Paris Fashion Week, featuring tie-dyed patchwork jackets and embroidery stitched by Afghan artisans through the non-profit Turquoise Mountain. The confirmed public show drew praise for spotlighting traditional craftsmanship on a global runway. The collection blends sustainability with artisanal heritage.
summary.zh_hans: 时装设计师 Gabriela Hearst 在巴黎时装周发表2027年春夏系列，包括扎染拼布外套，以及由阿富汗工匠透过非牟利组织 Turquoise Mountain 绣制的图案。这场已确认的公开发布会，让传统手工艺登上国际天桥，备受好评。系列糅合可持续理念与手工传承。
summary.zh_hant: 時裝設計師 Gabriela Hearst 在巴黎時裝週發表2027年春夏系列，包括扎染拼布外套，以及由阿富汗工匠透過非牟利組織 Turquoise Mountain 繡製的圖案。這場已確認的公開發布會，讓傳統手工藝登上國際天橋，備受好評。系列糅合可持續理念與手工傳承。

title.en: Gabriela Hearst showcases Afghan artisan embroidery at Paris Fashion Week

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs and the Sham Shui Po Police District conducted a joint operation against illicit cigarettes from September 18 to 30. Officers seized about 100,000 sticks of duty-not-paid cigarettes with an estimated market value of HK$480,000 and a duty potential of about HK$330,000. Five people aged between 30 and 75 were arrested; Customs reiterated that buying and selling illicit cigarettes is illegal.
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关与警务处深水埗警区于9月18日至30日展开联合执法行动打击私烟，共检获约10万支未完税香烟，市值约48万元，应课税值约33万元。行动中拘捕5名年龄介乎30至75岁的人士。海关重申买卖私烟属违法，会继续严厉执法。
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關與警務處深水埗警區於9月18日至30日展開聯合執法行動打擊私煙，共檢獲約10萬支未完稅香煙，市值約48萬元，應課稅值約33萬元。行動中拘捕5名年齡介乎30至75歲的人士。海關重申買賣私煙屬違法，會繼續嚴厲執法。

title.en: Customs and police seize 100,000 illicit cigarettes in joint Sham Shui Po operation

summary.en: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has applied to the EU intellectual property office to trademark her own voice, in a bid to combat AI deepfake abuse. The application, filed on October 5 with a four-second audio sample attached, follows her 2024 civil lawsuit against a man from Sardinia over deepfake content. The move marks one of the first attempts by a political leader to claim trademark protection over a voice.
summary.zh_hans: 意大利总理梅洛尼向欧盟知识产权局申请将自己的声音注册为商标，以打击AI深伪技术滥用。申请于10月5日提交，并附上一段4秒录音。此前她已在2024年就深伪内容对一名撒丁岛男子提出民事诉讼。今次是政治领袖首次尝试为声音申请商标保护。
summary.zh_hant: 意大利總理梅洛尼向歐盟知識產權局申請將自己的聲音註冊為商標，以打擊AI深偽技術濫用。申請於10月5日提交，並附上一段4秒錄音。此前她已在2024年就深偽內容對一名撒丁島男子提出民事訴訟。今次是政治領袖首次嘗試為聲音申請商標保護。

title.en: Italy's PM Meloni seeks EU trademark for her voice amid AI deepfake risks

summary.en: Germany's federal intelligence chief has warned that Germany faces the risk of violent conflict with Russia, as Moscow escalates its 'shadow war' against European democracies. The warning underscores growing alarm in Berlin over sabotage, cyberattacks and disinformation campaigns attributed to Russia. European security officials have been raising the alert level for months.
summary.zh_hans: 德国联邦情报局局长警告，随着俄罗斯对欧洲民主国家加剧「影子战争」，德国面临陷入暴力冲突的风险。有关警告反映柏林对俄罗斯被指发动的破坏、网络攻击及虚假信息行动日益警惕。欧洲安全官员近月来已不断提高警戒级别。
summary.zh_hant: 德國聯邦情報局局長警告，隨著俄羅斯對歐洲民主國家加劇「影子戰爭」，德國面臨陷入暴力衝突的風險。有關警告反映柏林對俄羅斯被指發動的破壞、網絡攻擊及虛假信息行動日益警惕。歐洲安全官員近月來已不斷提高警戒級別。

title.en: Germany at risk of violent conflict with Russia, intelligence chief warns

summary.en: Kai Tak Hospital began phased commissioning today, first opening its family medicine clinic for public registration. Visitors said the registration and waiting process went smoothly. Specialist outpatient services will be rolled out in batches from October 26.

summary.en: Co-produced by the Ministry of Public Security and China Media Group, the documentary series on the dismantling of northern Myanmar's telecom fraud operations premieres tonight with its first episode. It offers an exclusive look at the scam industry's dark ecosystem, including Chinese police's first entry into scam compounds in Kokang and investigations at sites such as Crouching Tiger Villa linked to the '10·20' shooting case.

summary.zh_hans: 由公安部与中央广播电视总台联合摄制的纪录片《缅北电诈覆灭纪实》今晚播出第一集《利剑出鞘》，独家曝光缅北电诈完整黑暗生态，包括中国警方首次获准进入缅北果敢电诈园区，对“10·20”枪击案涉及的卧虎山庄等地取证调查。

summary.en: Mark Houghton, the Hung Kuen disciple of martial-arts master Lau Kar-leung and a stuntman in 1980s Hong Kong action films, died of a sudden heart attack in Hong Kong in the early hours of October 5. Yung Ching-ching paid tribute, calling him Lau's "most loyal disciple." Houghton devoted his life to passing on the Lau family Hung Kuen tradition.
summary.zh_hans: 80年代香港动作电影龙虎武师、刘家良洪拳入室弟子何麦（Mark Houghton），10月5日凌晨突发心脏病在香港逝世。师母翁静晶发文哀悼，形容他是“刘家良最忠心的徒弟”。何麦一生致力传承刘家班洪拳，是备受尊崇的“黄飞鸿第五代传人”。
summary.zh_hant: 80年代香港動作電影龍虎武師、劉家良洪拳入室弟子何麥（Mark Houghton），10月5日凌晨突發心臟病在香港逝世。師母翁靜晶發文哀悼，形容他是「劉家良最忠心的徒弟」。何麥一生致力傳承劉家班洪拳，是備受尊崇的「黃飛鴻第五代傳人」。

title.en: Mark Houghton, Hung Kuen disciple of Lau Kar-leung, dies suddenly of heart attack
title.zh_hans: 刘家良洪拳入室弟子何麦心脏病发猝逝　翁静晶哀悼：最忠心的徒弟
title.zh_hant: 劉家良洪拳入室弟子何麥心臟病發猝逝　翁靜晶哀悼：最忠心的徒弟
智譜港股漲近5%　市值3206億港元　GLM 模型海外受認可
title.zh_hans: 智谱港股涨近5%　市值3206亿港元　GLM 模型海外受认可
title.en: Zhipu shares jump nearly 5% in Hong Kong as GLM models gain overseas recognition

summary.zh_hant: 智譜港股10月5日午盤報657.5港元，漲4.95%，市值達3206億港元。股價上漲主因其GLM大模型在海外獲得認可：Cursor近日上線GLM-5.3與5.3-Flash，並在CursorBench 4.0 Max上取得開源權重第一，德國主權AI公司Aleph Alpha的Kolibri模型亦採用GLM。
summary.zh_hans: 智谱港股10月5日午盘报657.5港元，涨4.95%，市值达3206亿港元。股价上涨主因其GLM大模型在海外获得认可：Cursor近日上线GLM-5.3与5.3-Flash，并在CursorBench 4.0 Max上取得开源权重第一，德国主权AI公司Aleph Alpha的Kolibri模型亦采用GLM。
summary.en: Zhipu's Hong Kong-listed shares traded at HK$657.5 at midday on October 5, up 4.95%, lifting its market value to HK$320.6 billion. The rally was driven by overseas recognition of its GLM large models: Cursor recently launched GLM-5.3 and 5.3-Flash, which topped open-weight results on CursorBench 4.0 Max, and Germany's sovereign AI firm Aleph Alpha adopted GLM for its Kolibri model.

title.zh_hant: 運輸署：皇崗口岸公共運輸交匯處資訊已就緒　按需要優化配套
title.zh_hans: 运输署：皇岗口岸公共运输交汇处资讯已就绪　按需要优化配套
title.en: Transport Department says Huanggang port public transport interchange information is ready

summary.zh_hant: 運輸署表示，皇崗口岸公共運輸交匯處已在各主要位置和上客區附近增設多個顯示屏，提供巴士及小巴路線目的地、途經站點、登車位置等資訊。署方指各項資訊已準備就緒，會按需要優化配套。
summary.zh_hans: 运输署表示，皇岗口岸公共运输交汇处已在各主要位置和上客区附近增设多个显示屏，提供巴士及小巴路线目的地、途经站点、登车位置等资讯。署方指各项资讯已准备就绪，会按需要优化配套。
summary.en: The Transport Department said multiple display screens have been added at key locations and near boarding areas of the Huanggang Port public transport interchange, showing bus and minibus destinations, stops and boarding points. It said all passenger information is ready and facilities will be fine-tuned as needed.

title.zh_hant: 私隱公署主動審查 24/7 FITNESS　跟進更衣室疑藏針孔鏡頭事件
title.zh_hans: 隐私公署主动审查 24/7 FITNESS　跟进更衣室疑藏针孔镜头事件
title.en: Privacy watchdog launches compliance check on 24/7 FITNESS over suspected hidden cameras

summary.zh_hant: 個人資料私隱專員公署留意到連鎖健身中心24/7 FITNESS早前被發現更衣室內懷疑藏有針孔攝錄鏡頭，引起會員對個人私隱的關注。公署已主動對該公司進行循規審查並要求提供資料。任何人士如懷疑個人資料私隱被侵犯，可向公署查詢或聯絡相關機構。
summary.zh_hans: 个人资料隐私专员公署留意到连锁健身中心24/7 FITNESS早前被发现更衣室内怀疑藏有针孔摄录镜头，引起会员对个人隐私的关注。公署已主动对该公司进行循规审查并要求提供资料。任何人士如怀疑个人资料隐私被侵犯，可向公署查询或联络相关机构。
summary.en: The Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data has taken note of reports that suspected pinhole cameras were found in the changing rooms of the 24/7 FITNESS gym chain, raising members' privacy concerns. The watchdog has proactively launched a compliance check on the company and requested information. Anyone who suspects their personal data privacy has been violated can contact the office.

title.zh_hant: 元朗「勝利牛丸」分店11月中結業　44年老字號僅剩一店
title.zh_hans: 元朗「胜利牛丸」分店11月中结业　44年老字号仅剩一店
title.en: Yuen Long's 44-year-old Victory Beef Ball to close branch, leaving one shop

summary.zh_hant: 1982年創立、屹立元朗逾40年的老字號「勝利牛丸」，其谷亭街分店門前貼出告示，預告11月中停止營運。職員證實停業但拒絕透露原因，品牌將只剩一間分店。消息曝光後網民反應兩極，有街坊對經營困難表示惋惜。
summary.zh_hans: 1982年创立、屹立元朗逾40年的老字号「胜利牛丸」，其谷亭街分店门前贴出告示，预告11月中停止营运。职员证实停业但拒绝透露原因，品牌将只剩一间分店。消息曝光后网民反应两极，有街坊对经营困难表示惋惜。
summary.en: Victory Beef Ball, a Yuen Long institution founded in 1982, will close its Kuk Ting Street branch in mid-November, according to a notice posted at the shop. Staff confirmed the closure but declined to give a reason, leaving the brand with a single store. The news drew mixed reactions online, with some locals lamenting the difficult business environment.

title.zh_hant: 美軍撤回駐英基地全部12架 B-1 轟炸機　時機惹關注
title.zh_hans: 美军撤回驻英基地全部12架 B-1 轰炸机　时机惹关注
title.en: US withdraws all 12 B-1 bombers from UK base in highly unusual move

summary.zh_hant: 據《紐約時報》、BBC等外媒報道，兩名美國官員表示，美方已於當地時間10月4日將部署在英國費爾福德空軍基地的全部12架B-1轟炸機撤回美國本土，《紐約時報》形容此舉「非常不尋常」。撤軍時機緊隨英國警方9月27日拘捕多名涉嫌策劃針對該基地恐怖行動的人員。五角大樓稱轟炸機已重新部署至本土基地，仍具全球精確打擊能力。
summary.zh_hans: 据《纽约时报》、BBC等外媒报道，两名美国官员表示，美方已于当地时间10月4日将部署在英国费尔福德空军基地的全部12架B-1轰炸机撤回美国本土，《纽约时报》形容此举「非常不寻常」。撤军时机紧随英国警方9月27日拘捕多名涉嫌策划针对该基地恐怖行动的人员。五角大楼称轰炸机已重新部署至本土基地，仍具全球精确打击能力。
summary.en: Citing two US officials, the New York Times and the BBC reported that Washington withdrew all 12 B-1 bombers deployed at RAF Fairford in Britain back to the United States on October 4 local time — a move the Times called "highly unusual." The timing follows British police arrests on September 27 of several people suspected of plotting a terrorist attack on the base. The Pentagon said the bombers have been redeployed to domestic bases and retain global precision-strike capability.

Student protests in France continue to escalate: the education minister said 24 schools have been torched or ransacked and nearly 500 schools closed on October 5. Students are protesting strained education resources, including teacher shortages, overcrowded classes and dilapidated school buildings. The protests erupted last week and have spread beyond Paris to multiple cities.
summary.zh_hans: 法国学生抗议持续延烧，教育部长表示已有24所学校遭纵火或洗劫，近500所学校10月5日停课。示威学生主要不满教育资源紧张，包括教师人数不足、班级人数过多及校舍失修。抗议于上周爆发，已蔓延至巴黎以外的多个城市。
summary.zh_hant: 法國學生抗議持續延燒，教育部長表示已有24所學校遭縱火或洗劫，近500所學校10月5日停課。示威學生主要不滿教育資源緊張，包括教師人數不足、班級人數過多及校舍失修。抗議於上周爆發，已蔓延至巴黎以外的多個城市。

title.en: France student protests escalate: 24 schools torched, nearly 500 closed on October 5
title.zh_hans: 法国学生示威持续延烧　24所学校遭纵火　近500所学校10月5日停课
title.zh_hant: 法國學生示威持續延燒　24所學校遭縱火　近500所學校10月5日停課

summary.en: HKIC chief executive Clara Chan disclosed that the world's first offshore renminbi venture capital fund has launched in Hong Kong and begun investing in AI and brain-computer interface projects. Chan also revealed 11 portfolio companies have listed in Hong Kong, with over 30 more planning to file for IPOs within the year.
summary.zh_hans: 香港投资管理有限公司行政总裁陈家齐披露，全球首个离岸人民币创投基金已在香港启动，已开始投资人工智能及脑机接口项目。陈家齐亦透露，已有11家被投企业在港上市，另有30余家计划在今年内提交港股上市申请。
summary.zh_hant: 香港投資管理有限公司行政總裁陳家齊披露，全球首個離岸人民幣創投基金已在香港啟動，已開始投資人工智能及腦機接口項目。陳家齊亦透露，已有11家被投企業在港上市，另有30餘家計劃在今年內提交港股上市申請。

title.en: World's first offshore yuan venture fund launches in Hong Kong, targeting AI

title.zh_hant: 全球首個離岸人民幣創投基金香港啟動　落地人工智能賽道
啟德醫院首日運作暢順　家庭醫學綜合中心率先啟用
title.zh_hans: 启德医院首日运作畅顺　家庭医学综合中心率先启用
title.en: Kai Tak Hospital opens smoothly on first day; family medicine centre leads phased launch

summary.zh_hant: 啟德醫院今日起分階段啟用，位於「專科門診大樓」一樓的家庭醫學綜合中心率先投入運作，初期每日提供約350個家庭醫學診所診症名額，首日早上運作暢順。專科門診服務將於本月26日起分批開展。
summary.zh_hans: 启德医院今日起分阶段启用，位于「专科门诊大楼」一楼的家庭医学综合中心率先投入运作，初期每日提供约350个家庭医学诊所诊症名额，首日早上运作畅顺。专科门诊服务将于本月26日起分批开展。
summary.en: Kai Tak Hospital began its phased opening on Monday, with the integrated family medicine centre on the first floor of the specialist outpatient building starting service first, offering about 350 family medicine appointments a day initially. Operations ran smoothly on the first morning. Specialist outpatient services will roll out in phases from the 26th of this month.

On day five of the National Day golden week, Hong Kong's catering industry expects average daily revenue of HK$250 million for the holiday, up more than 10% year on year. Catering trade chief Simon Wong said National Day itself brought in HK$320 million. Immigration data showed more than 931,000 mainland visitors in the first four days.
summary.zh_hans: 国庆黄金周踏入第五天，香港餐饮业界预计整个黄金周平均每日营业额达2.5亿港元，按年升逾一成。香港餐饮联业协会会长黄家和表示，国庆当日已录得3.2亿元生意额。入境处数据显示，首四日访港的内地旅客累计逾93.1万人次。
summary.zh_hant: 國慶黃金周踏入第五天，香港餐飲業界預計整個黃金周平均每日營業額達2.5億港元，按年升逾一成。香港餐飲聯業協會會長黃家和表示，國慶當日已錄得3.2億元生意額。入境處數據顯示，首四日訪港的內地旅客累計逾93.1萬人次。

title.en: Hong Kong golden week boom: restaurants expect average daily revenue of HK$250 million
title.zh_hans: 国庆黄金周香港丁财两旺　餐饮业料日均收入2.5亿
title.zh_hant: 國慶黃金周香港丁財兩旺　餐飲業料日均收入2.5億
李家超：首份五年規劃及施政報告均把年輕人放中心位置
title.zh_hans: 李家超：首份五年规划及施政报告均把年轻人放中心位置
title.en: John Lee: Hong Kong's first five-year plan and policy address both put youth at the centre

summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超出席活動時表示，香港首份五年規劃和新一份施政報告都把年輕人放在中心位置。他又指香港在一國兩制下，於國家和世界之間擁有獨特地位，擔當「超級聯繫人」及「超級增值人」的角色。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超出席活动时表示，香港首份五年规划和新一份施政报告都把年轻人放在中心位置。他又指香港在一国两制下，于国家和世界之间拥有独特地位，担当「超级联系人」及「超级增值人」的角色。
summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee said at an event that Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the upcoming policy address both place young people at the centre. He added that under "one country, two systems," Hong Kong occupies a unique position between the country and the world, serving as a "super-connector" and "super value-adder."

title.zh_hant: 也門戰事升級　油輪紅海連遭爆炸　胡塞與沙特互相空襲
title.zh_hans: 也门战事升级　油轮红海连遭爆炸　胡塞与沙特互相空袭
title.en: Yemen conflict escalates as tanker hit by blasts in Red Sea; Houthis and Saudi Arabia trade air strikes

summary.zh_hant: 英國海事貿易運營辦公室10月4日通報，一艘油輪在也門木哈附近海域連遭多次爆炸。胡塞武裝與沙特之間互相空襲，戰火由美以伊衝突外溢。分析指襲擊令紅海航運安全與沙伊博弈再添變數，地區局勢會否進一步升溫有待觀察。
summary.zh_hans: 英国海事贸易运营办公室10月4日通报，一艘油轮在也门木哈附近海域连遭多次爆炸。胡塞武装与沙特之间互相空袭，战火由美以伊冲突外溢。分析指袭击令红海航运安全与沙伊博弈再添变数，地区局势会否进一步升温有待观察。
summary.en: The UK Maritime Trade Operations office reported on October 4 that an oil tanker was hit by multiple explosions near Mokha, Yemen, in the Red Sea. The Houthis and Saudi Arabia have traded air strikes as the conflict spills over from US-Israel-Iran tensions. Analysts say the attack adds uncertainty to Red Sea shipping security and the Saudi-Iran rivalry, with the risk of further escalation unclear.

Brazil's Superior Electoral Court has announced the first-round results of the presidential election, with no candidate securing more than half the votes for an outright win. Incumbent President Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, will advance to a runoff. Flavio briefly led during the vote count with just over half the votes.
summary.zh_hans: 巴西高等选举法院公布总统选举首轮投票结果，没有候选人取得过半数选票直接当选。现任总统卢拉与前总统博尔索纳罗之子弗拉维奥，将进入第二轮投票。点票期间弗拉维奥一度暂时领先，得票略过半。
summary.zh_hant: 巴西高等選舉法院公布總統選舉首輪投票結果，沒有候選人取得過半數選票直接當選。現任總統盧拉與前總統博爾索納羅之子弗拉維奧，將進入第二輪投票。點票期間弗拉維奧一度暫時領先，得票略過半。

title.en: Brazil presidential race heads to runoff between Lula and Bolsonaro's son

title.zh_hant: 巴西總統選舉　盧拉與博爾索納羅之子進入第二輪投票

summary.en: Japanese stocks opened higher on Monday morning, with the Nikkei average rising 1,203 points, or about 1.76%, to 69,513 in early trading. South Korean markets were closed for a public holiday.
summary.zh_hans: 日本股市今晨开市初段向好，日经平均指数报 69,513 点，升 1,203 点，升幅约 1.76%。韩国股市则因假期休市。
summary.zh_hant: 日本股市今晨開市初段向好，日經平均指數報 69,513 點，升 1,203 點，升幅約 1.76%。韓國股市則因假期休市。

title.en: Japanese stocks open nearly 2% higher; South Korean market closed for holiday

title.zh_hant: 日股初段升近 2%　韓股因假期休市

summary.en: A Shanghai buyer purchased coriander worth 8.59 yuan online and was granted a 'refund-only' claim by the e-commerce platform after complaining the goods did not match the description. The seller, Mr Zhu from Xuzhou in Jiangsu, refused to accept losing both the money and the goods, and drove nearly 1,000 km round trip to Shanghai to retrieve the coriander in person, spending almost 1,000 yuan on fuel and tolls. The case has sparked heated online debate over abuse of the 'refund-only' mechanism, with many small sellers saying they have long suffered from malicious claims.
summary.zh_hans: 上海一名买家网购价值 8.59 元人民币的芫荽后，以货不对办为由获电商平台批准「仅退款」兼免退货。江苏徐州卖家朱先生不服钱货两空，决定自驾来回近 1,000 公里亲身到上海取回芫荽，单是油费连路费已花近千元。事件曝光后在网上引发两极讨论，不少网店卖家力挺朱先生，直指业界长年深受「恶意仅退款」所苦；亦有人认为卖家耗费大量时间金钱追货并不划算。
summary.zh_hant: 上海一名買家網購價值 8.59 元人民幣的芫荽後，以貨不對辦為由獲電商平台批准「僅退款」兼免退貨。江蘇徐州賣家朱先生不服錢貨兩空，決定自駕來回近 1,000 公里親身到上海取回芫荽，單是油費連路費已花近千元。事件曝光後在網上引發兩極討論，不少網店賣家力挺朱先生，直指業界長年深受「惡意僅退款」所苦；亦有人認為賣家耗費大量時間金錢追貨並不划算。

title.en: Seller drives 1,000 km to reclaim 8.6-yuan coriander after buyer's refund-only claim
title.zh_hans: 网售 8.6 元芫荽被申「仅退款」　卖家驾车千里取菜：咽不下这口气
title.zh_hant: 網售 8.6 元芫荽被申「僅退款」　賣家駕車千里取菜：嚥不下呢口氣

summary.en: Following the Dubai airline cockpit attack, Israel's transport ministry has tightened restrictions on foreign aircrew, barring crew holding sole or dual nationality of 27 countries including Iran, Iraq, Oman and Saudi Arabia from operating or travelling on flights to Israel. Australian authorities are meanwhile investigating whether the co-pilot accused in the attack was radicalised locally.
summary.zh_hans: 鉴于迪拜航空客机驾驶舱袭击案，以色列交通部收紧对外国机组人员的限制，严禁拥有伊朗、伊拉克、阿曼、沙特阿拉伯等 27 国单一或双重国籍的机组人员，执飞或乘坐前往以色列的航班。澳洲方面正调查涉案副机长是否在当地被极端化。
summary.zh_hant: 鑑於迪拜航空客機駕駛艙襲擊案，以色列交通部收緊對外國機組人員的限制，嚴禁擁有伊朗、伊拉克、阿曼、沙特阿拉伯等 27 國單一或雙重國籍的機組人員，執飛或乘坐前往以色列的航班。澳洲方面正調查涉案副機長是否在當地被極端化。

title.en: Israel tightens curbs on foreign aircrew after Dubai cockpit attack; Australia probes co-pilot

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has announced the creation of a 'Super Intelligence' task force to coordinate the federal government's work on artificial intelligence. Trump signed an executive order last month renaming AI as 'super intelligence' (SI). Led by Director of National Intelligence Clayton, who also serves as the White House AI chief, the task force will coordinate interaction between the federal government, consumers, NGOs, critical infrastructure providers and businesses to keep the United States the global leader in AI, reporting directly to the president and the White House chief of staff.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普宣布成立「超级智能」工作组，协调联邦政府各项有关人工智能的工作。特朗普上月底签署行政命令，将人工智能 AI 改称为超级智能 SI。工作组由国家情报总监兼白宫人工智能事务主管克莱顿领导，直接向总统及白宫办公室主任汇报，负责协调联邦政府与消费者、非政府组织、关键基础设施供应商及企业之间的互动，确保美国在人工智能领域继续保持全球领先地位。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普宣布成立「超級智能」工作組，協調聯邦政府各項有關人工智能的工作。特朗普上月底簽署行政命令，將人工智能 AI 改稱為超級智能 SI。工作組由國家情報總監兼白宮人工智能事務主管克萊頓領導，直接向總統及白宮辦公室主任彙報，負責協調聯邦政府與消費者、非政府組織、關鍵基礎設施供應商及企業之間的互動，確保美國在人工智能領域繼續保持全球領先地位。

title.en: Trump launches 'Super Intelligence' task force to keep US ahead in AI

summary.en: Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with a cold front, temperatures across most parts of Hong Kong were about two degrees lower this morning than yesterday. The Observatory forecasts temperatures between 25 and 31 degrees today, with urban lows falling to around 23 degrees tomorrow and Wednesday, a couple of degrees lower in the New Territories.

title.en: Cool northeasterly winds bring temperatures 2 degrees lower across Hong Kong

summary.en: The co-pilot accused of attacking the captain in a Dubai airline cockpit has reportedly admitted to investigators that he planned to seize control of the aircraft and crash it into Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv. Israeli media reported that the suspect, Hamami, intended to wait until the plane entered Jordanian airspace before attacking the captain, and hoped to strike the terminal before Israeli forces could intercept. Investigators earlier said he appeared to have acted alone with no links to any militant group.
summary.zh_hans: 迪拜航空客机驾驶舱袭击案，据报涉嫌施袭的副机长哈马米向调查人员承认，原本计划操控飞机撞向以色列特拉维夫本古里安机场。以色列传媒报道，他打算等客机飞到约旦领空时袭击机长、取得飞机控制权，再在以军来不及拦截之前撞向客运大楼。调查人员早前表示，初步估计哈马米是单独行动，与任何激进组织没有关联。
summary.zh_hant: 迪拜航空客機駕駛艙襲擊案，據報涉嫌施襲嘅副機長哈馬米向調查人員承認，原本計劃操控飛機撞向以色列特拉維夫本古里安機場。以色列傳媒報道，佢打算等客機飛到約旦領空時襲擊機長、取得飛機控制權，再喺以軍趕唔切攔截之前撞向客運大樓。調查人員早前表示，初步估計哈馬米係單獨行動，同任何激進組織冇關聯。

title.en: Dubai airline cockpit attack: co-pilot allegedly planned to ram plane into Tel Aviv airport

summary.en: Jewellery worth about HK$800,000 has gone missing from a flat at Caribbean Coast in Tung Chung. The 59-year-old foreign male householder reported the case at around 9:57 pm last night. Police have arrested a 33-year-old Filipina domestic helper, and the case is being investigated as theft.

summary.en: A shooting in Baltimore, Maryland's largest city, left a 12-year-old girl dead from a suspected stray bullet on Saturday afternoon. Police said two men exchanged gunfire near a park after a dispute over a parking space, and the girl and a woman nearby were hit. The woman sustained minor injuries, and no arrests have been made so far.
summary.zh_hans: 美国马里兰州最大城市巴尔的摩星期六下午发生枪击案，两名男子疑因争泊车位开枪，一名12岁女童怀疑中流弹身亡。警方说两人在公园附近口角后互相开枪，公园内一名女童和一名女子中流弹。女子伤势较轻没有生命危险，暂时未有人被捕。
summary.zh_hant: 美國馬里蘭州最大城市巴爾的摩星期六下午發生槍擊案，兩名男子疑因爭泊車位開槍，一名12歲女童懷疑中流彈身亡。警方話兩人喺公園附近口角後互相開槍，公園內一名女童同一名女子中流彈。女子傷勢較輕冇生命危險，暫時未有人被捕。

title.en: Baltimore shooting: 12-year-old girl killed by suspected stray bullet after parking dispute

summary.en: Police arrested the woman suspected of wielding a knife at Diamond Hill MTR station last night after firefighters forced open a flat door at Ching Wai House in Tsz Ching Estate, Tsz Wan Shan. Police said the station reported at 6:50pm that a woman carrying what appeared to be a ceramic knife struck the customer service counter before leaving. She was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital after her arrest.
summary.zh_hans: 钻石山港铁站傍晚怀疑女子持刀案，警员昨晚在慈云山慈正邨正晖楼一个单位，经消防破门入屋后拘捕涉案女子并送院。警方说昨晚6时50分接港铁钻石山站职员报案，指一名女子手持相信是陶瓷刀的利器，敲打客务中心柜台后离开。涉案女子被捕后送往伊利沙伯医院。
summary.zh_hant: 鑽石山港鐵站傍晚懷疑女子持刀案，警員昨晚喺慈雲山慈正邨正暉樓一個單位，經消防破門入屋後拘捕涉案女子並送院。警方話昨晚6時50分接港鐵鑽石山站職員報案，指一名女子手持相信係陶瓷刀嘅利器，敲打客務中心櫃枱後離開。涉案女子被捕後送往伊利沙伯醫院。

summary.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv and met Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, announcing an additional €1 billion in German military aid to Ukraine. Merz said €350 million of the package will go toward repairing energy infrastructure, stressing Germany remains Ukraine's staunchest supporter for the sake of European security. The two sides also signed more than a dozen government and defence-industry agreements worth about €6.5 billion.
summary.zh_hans: 德国总理默茨到访基辅，同乌克兰总统泽连斯基会面，宣布德国将向乌克兰追加10亿欧元军事援助。默茨说追加援助当中有3亿5千万欧元会用于修复能源基建，强调德国一直是乌克兰最坚定的支持者。两国政府和军工企业之间亦签署十几份协议，价值大约65亿欧元，涵盖防空导弹、雷达设备和喷射无人机拦截器。
summary.zh_hant: 德國總理默茨到訪基輔，同烏克蘭總統澤連斯基會面，宣布德國將向烏克蘭追加10億歐元軍事援助。默茨話追加援助當中有3億5千萬歐元會用於修復能源基建，強調德國一直係烏克蘭最堅定嘅支持者。兩國政府同軍工企業之間亦簽署十幾份協議，價值大約65億歐元，涵蓋防空導彈、雷達設備同噴射無人機攔截器。

title.en: German Chancellor Merz visits Kyiv, pledges €1 billion in additional military aid to Ukraine

summary.en: Russia launched drone strikes on Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine overnight, killing at least one person and injuring six, Ukrainian officials said. President Zelenskyy said Russia fired 135 attack drones from Saturday night into Sunday morning, damaging infrastructure across multiple regions and causing power outages. Russia's defence ministry confirmed the strikes, describing them as retaliation for Ukrainian actions including attacks on civilian facilities.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰说首都基辅等地遭到俄罗斯无人机袭击，最少1死6伤。总统泽连斯基说星期六晚至星期日凌晨，俄军一共向乌克兰境内发射135架攻击型无人机，多个州基建受损、部分地区停电。俄罗斯国防部证实发动打击，说是回应乌克兰一系列行为，包括袭击俄罗斯民用设施、以图破坏国家杜马选举。
summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭話首都基輔等地遭到俄羅斯無人機襲擊，最少1死6傷。總統澤連斯基話星期六晚至星期日凌晨，俄軍一共向烏克蘭境內發射135架攻擊型無人機，多個州基建受損、部分地區停電。俄羅斯國防部證實發動打擊，話係回應烏克蘭一系列行為，包括襲擊俄羅斯民用設施、以圖破壞國家杜馬選舉。

title.en: Russian drone strikes hit Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, killing at least one and injuring six

summary.en: Seven major oil producers including Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman held an online meeting and agreed to keep November output at September levels. Reports say Gulf producers' exports have hovered at only about 60% of normal levels in recent months amid Middle East tensions.

summary.en: HKU's new vice-president (research) Charles Wang Sze-tsan says the university's "RISE" framework will connect research, innovation, strategic partnerships and entrepreneurship from the earliest stages of research, rather than only after results emerge. He wants universities to help scientists bridge funding, business-model and scaling hurdles so discoveries reach real-world use. HKU will host its InnoFest 2026 innovation festival from October 12 to 16, showcasing more than 120 research and innovation projects.
summary.zh_hant: 港大新任副校長（研究）岑浩璋表示，大學正透過「RISE」框架，整合研究、創新、策略協作及創業支援，嘗試將產學研合作由科研成果完成後嘅接洽，提前至研究初期，等產業需要同大學科研方向及早對接。佢話大學除咗推動前沿研究，亦要協助科研成果跨越資金、商業模式同技術規模化等關卡。港大將於10月12至16日舉行「港大創新節2026」，展示逾120項科研項目。
summary.zh_hans: 港大新任副校长（研究）岑浩璋表示，大学正透过「RISE」框架，整合研究、创新、策略协作及创业支援，尝试将产学研合作由科研成果完成后的接洽，提前至研究初期，让产业需要与大学科研方向及早对接。他说大学除了推动前沿研究，亦要协助科研成果跨越资金、商业模式及技术规模化等关卡。港大将于10月12至16日举行「港大创新节2026」，展示逾120项科研项目。
